gui.wikirenderer.background_color.toolti: The static background color to also render, if shown using the option below.
gui.wikirenderer.show_background_color_i: Controls if the specified background color is rendered.
gui.wikirenderer.texture_animations.tool: Controls if textures that are animated are allowed to tick and automatically update.
gui.wikirenderer.sync_texture_animations: Controls if animated texture timings are synced to the animation's current frame number.
gui.wikirenderer.full_bright.tooltip: Renders the area with a high gamma value.
gui.wikirenderer.render_as_daytime.toolt: Renders the area as if it's daytime.
gui.wikirenderer.night_vision.tooltip: Renders the area with the night vision effect.
gui.wikirenderer.light_up_surrounding_bl: Controls if the lighting calculation uses fully lit lighting for blocks outside the area or their actual lighting, which is typically dark for solid blocks.
gui.wikirenderer.show_surrounding_partic: Allows surrounding particles in a specified radius to be shown.
Warning: Showing surrounding particles without using the Live Entities option may cause particle positions to become offset.
gui.wikirenderer.loop_particles.tooltip: Controls whether or not particles in animation exports are looped, which is done by showing old particles towards the end and not rendering particles that would break the loop. Requires an export FPS of 20 and Render with Game Timings turned on.
gui.wikirenderer.allow_scaling_with_mous: Controls if you can zoom with your mouse on the render to scale it. Keep this off to prevent accidental scaling. This option is hidden if cropping and rescaling is turned on.
gui.wikirenderer.sync_rotation_to_animat: Controls if the rotation is synced to the animation's current frame number.
gui.wikirenderer.allow_rotating_with_mou: Controls if you can drag click your mouse on the render to rotate it. Keep this off to prevent accidental rotations.
gui.wikirenderer.force_enchanted.tooltip: Forces the enchantment glint to show on items that support it.
gui.wikirenderer.override_dye_color.tool: Overrides the dye color on dyeable items, like leather armor.
gui.wikirenderer.hide_tooltip_background: Controls if the tooltip background is hidden. Hiding it can be useful for rendering single unicode characters.
gui.wikirenderer.batch.export_as_animati: Allows you to export each batch entry as an animation.
The preset used to generate each batch entry's file name.
gui.wikirenderer.incomplete_animation: This animation hasn't fully looped yet and is considered incomplete.
gui.wikirenderer.use_manual_frame_timing: Allows you to set the tick timing for each frame. This works better on animated player head textures, compared to animated dyed armor.
gui.wikirenderer.manual_frame_timing.too: Sets the tick timing for each frame.
gui.wikirenderer.export_profile_data.too: Exports an additional json file with the Game Profiles used in each texture.
gui.wikirenderer.copied_profile_data_to_: Copy raw profile data to clipboard
gui.wikirenderer.frame_options_override_: Export FPS and Frame counts are determined by the animation data and cannot be manually set.
gui.wikirenderer.armor_data_gif_force_cr: Additionally, animated dyed armor renders automatically use crop and rescaling on the longer side for GIFs.

gui.wikirenderer.per_pixel_90_degree_ren: Allows you to render specific sides of the area with pixel-level precision.
gui.wikirenderer.walkability_filter.tool: Allows you to more easily render just underground blocks.
gui.wikirenderer.show_walls.tooltip: Makes it so blocks that are adjacent to underground blocks that normally aren't rendered get shown.
gui.wikirenderer.show_corner_walls.toolt: Makes it so blocks adjacent to wall blocks are also shown. These are typically darker, though.
gui.wikirenderer.require_ceiling.tooltip: Controls whether or not blocks are only rendered if there blocks (a ceiling) above them.
gui.wikirenderer.half_pixel_offset_for_4: This option helps fix things like fence lines not rendering, but may impact sharpness.
Controls if mesh expansion buttons are shown.
gui.wikirenderer.freeze_blocks.tooltip: Prevents mesh sections from automatically updating when blocks change in the world.
gui.wikirenderer.hide_items.tooltip: Controls if inventory items are prevented from rendering.
gui.wikirenderer.unicode_font_mismatched: Note: Force Unicode Font is currently enabled, and Minecraft normally forces GUI scale intervals of 2 when this is on. Consider using an export scale that is an interval of 2.
gui.wikirenderer.override_rotations.tool: Allows you to override the rotations of all rendered entities in the area.
gui.wikirenderer.override_dragon_flap_an: Controls if the Ender Dragon flap animation is overwritten.
gui.wikirenderer.sprite_rendering.toolti: Enables a separate sprite rendering mode, which only shows entity head models and has separate transformation controls.
gui.wikirenderer.entity_data.use_live_en: Controls if the actual entities in game are used (which automatically update and can move around), or if frozen ones are used.
gui.wikirenderer.entity_animations.toolt: Controls if certain entity animations render, by not freezing its age in ticks value.
gui.wikirenderer.show_surrounding_entiti: Controls if surrounding entities around the main entity are also shown.
gui.wikirenderer.auto_refresh_visible_en: Controls if the list of surrounding visible entities are automatically refreshed based on the radius.
gui.wikirenderer.show_hidden_surrounding: Allows you to hide specific surrounding entity types.
gui.wikirenderer.show_hidden_entities_li: Allows you prevent specific entity types from rendering.
gui.wikirenderer.entity_collision_thresh: Controls what percentage of the entity's rendered hitbox has to overlap with the area bounds for it to render. This can affect entities on the edge of the bounds.
gui.wikirenderer.selected_entity_refresh: Controls how the list of visible entities is refreshed.
gui.wikirenderer.override_head_rotations: Controls if entity head yaw/pitch rotations are overwritten.
gui.wikirenderer.override_body_rotations: Controls if entity body rotations are overwritten.
gui.wikirenderer.entity_data.hide_red_da: Hides the red damage glow for entities that have recently been damaged.
gui.wikirenderer.entity_data.steve.toolt: Renders players with the default Steve skin.
gui.wikirenderer.entity_data.hide_held_i: Hides any held items on rendered entities.
Hides any armor on rendered entities.
gui.wikirenderer.entity_data.hide_enchan: Hides any enchantment glints on items held or worn by rendered entities.
gui.wikirenderer.entity_data.invisible.t: Renders entities as if they're invisible.
gui.wikirenderer.advanced_entity_data_no: Note: Some settings may have no visual impact or rely on other settings to be considered.
gui.wikirenderer.advanced_entity_data_ac: Tip: Select an entity in the preview to access more advanced overrides!
gui.wikirenderer.crop.tooltip: Controls if the export should be automatically cropped on all sides to reduce blank pixels.
gui.wikirenderer.crop_and_rescale_vertic: Exported images will be rescaled vertically (by rendering it multiple times) to the desired height resolution.
gui.wikirenderer.crop_and_rescale_horizo: Exported images will be rescaled horizontally (by rendering it multiple times) to the desired width resolution.
gui.wikirenderer.crop_and_rescale_shorte: Exported images will be rescaled (by rendering it multiple times) to the desired shorter side resolution.
gui.wikirenderer.crop_and_rescale_longer: Exported images will be rescaled (by rendering it multiple times) to the desired longer side resolution.
gui.wikirenderer.crop_and_rescale_disabl: Controls if the export should be automatically cropped on all sides to reduce blank pixels.
gui.wikirenderer.dump_into_root.tooltip: If enabled, exported images and animations will be placed into the renders folder, instead of sub-folders within it.
gui.wikirenderer.overwrite_latest.toolti: If enabled, exported images and animations will override images with duplicate file names, instead of appending a number at the end.
gui.wikirenderer.export_minimap_data.too: Exports an additional file for minimap data, which is designed for use on the Hypixel SkyBlock Wiki.
gui.wikirenderer.converting_image_sequen: Converting image sequence to target format

gui.wikirenderer.renderer_resolution_res: The target height resolution of the image (using rescaling).

gui.wikirenderer.block_resolution.toolti: The resolution of each block, which add up to the final resolution.
gui.wikirenderer.font_resolution.tooltip: The resolution of each standard sized font pixel.
gui.wikirenderer.gui_scale_resolution.to: The GUI scale used to calculate the resolution of the exported image.
gui.wikirenderer.item_resolution.tooltip: The resolution of each exported 2D/flat item image.
gui.wikirenderer.block_item_resolution.t: The resolution of each exported 3D/block-based item image.
gui.wikirenderer.file_name.tooltip: The file name of the exported image or animation. If the name is already taken and overwrite latest file isn't on, a number will be added to the end of it.
gui.wikirenderer.shader_animations_unsup: Animation Exports are not supported with Shaders.
When enabled, the individual frames folder will not be deleted when the export finishes.
gui.wikirenderer.animation_frames.toolti: Sets the total amount of frames in the animation. The duration is then derived by the framerate. Max 5,000.
gui.wikirenderer.animation_framerate.too: Sets the amount of frames rendered per second in the animation. Max 100.
gui.wikirenderer.sync_enchantment_glints: Controls if enchant glints are synced to the animation's current frame number.
gui.wikirenderer.speed_up_enchantment_gl: Significantly speeds up the enchant glint timing loop, allowing for smaller animation files.
gui.wikirenderer.render_with_game_timing: When enabled, the game's FPS will be capped to the animation FPS, ensuring timings line up with the game's timings. Syncing certain things like enchant glints or rotations may allow you to safely turn this off without any side effects.

message.wikirenderer.sb_cosmetic_renderi:
Keybind Overrides for Animated Hypixel SkyBlock Cosmetics §aenabled§7.
For animated player heads on entities (Pet Skins, Power Orbs, Helmet Skins, etc), select the item in a menu for rendering to set it as the first frame, then try and render the entity. Letting multiple loops play leads to better results.
For animated dyed armor, render the entity used to preview the dyed armor.
